title: Rav Acha bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 3b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.3b.29), Rav Acha bar Bizna speaks in the name of Rabbi Shimon Chasida. Hyman calls Acha a scribal error and says the name should read Rav Chana bar Bizna, who, he says, always speaks in Rabbi Shimon Chasida’s name, as in [Berakhot 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.7a.33) and [Menachot 35b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.35b.8). Hyman reports that Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim have the same reading.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot 3b has Acha, and the two tefillin passages have Chana. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1378&lang=en) also proposes correcting Acha and notes a further variant in Ein Yaakov.
